subject: Billing & PO process for Redwood services
messages:
From: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mark.liu@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: 2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing & PO process for Redwood services

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Greenfield is excited about the performance profile. Before legal executes the MSA, our procurement team needs to confirm a few billing items so we can map the vendor into our AP system:

- We require a formal Purchase Order on file that references each monthly invoice (PO number on invoice line items).
- Payment terms: Net45 from invoice date (our standard).
- Invoice cadence: consolidated monthly statement preferred (single PDF with all charge lines for the month).
- Remit-to and tax information: we need Redwood's remit address and W9/Tax ID for our vendor onboarding form.

I attached our PO template for your finance team to review. Please let me know if Redwood can accept Net45 and consolidated monthly statements or if you have standard constraints (e.g., Net30, per-invoice billing). If Net45 is possible we'd like confirmation and any required addenda.

Also include a billing contact email so we can whitelist for AP.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Brooks
Head of Procurement | Greenfield Health
Attachment: Greenfield_PO_Template.pdf

From: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: mark.liu@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: 2026-03-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing & PO process for Redwood services

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the PO template.

Short answers up front: we can accept a PO on file and include the PO number on invoice lines; consolidated monthly statements are fine. Net45 is not our default for hosted pay-as-you-go usage (we operate on Net30), but for committed/dedicated arrangements we can accommodate Net45 with an approved credit exception and a signed addendum to the MSA.

Next steps I propose:
- I’m attaching an updated quote (quote_v3.pdf) showing the Dedicated pool pricing and the proposed one-time onboarding credit.
- I’ll route your request to Finance for a Net45 exception and confirm whether a small processing fee or payment milestone is required.
- Please confirm the exact billing contact and remit details you’ll use (accounts.payable@greenfieldhealth.com?).

Would you be able to provide the completed vendor onboarding form and a point of contact for AP? Once we have a PO number I can loop Legal to attach the addendum and get DocuSign out.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: quote_v3.pdf

Ben / Marissa,

Looping you in — Greenfield (GFH-2026-042) asked for Net45 and consolidated monthly statements. They will provide a PO and vendor onboarding form; attached is their PO template and my proposed quote.

Key commercial context:
- ARR (first-year estimate): ~$420k (Dedicated pool + platform fees).
- They want Net45 and single monthly PDF for AP reconciliation.
- Sales is proposing a one-time 10% onboarding credit to help land the commit.

Requests:
1) Can Finance approve a Net45 payment term for this customer for the first 12 months?
2) If we approve, do you require a processing fee or invoice holdback?
3) Confirm the wording we need on the MSA addendum to capture Net45 + PO requirement.

If Finance signs off, I’ll send an MSA addendum and DocuSign to Greenfield. Need approval ideally by EOD 3/19 to keep the renewal/implementation timeline.

Thanks — Hannah

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Greenfield PO / Net45 request — need finance exception

Hannah — thanks for the context. Finance is OK to grant Net45 for Strategic customers with committed spend, subject to the following:

- We need a signed PO on file prior to the first invoice. PO must reference the Redwood invoice number fields and the MSA addendum.
- Net45 approved for 12 months with a review at renewal.
- To mitigate credit risk, add a 1% processing fee on invoices with Net45, or alternatively require a 25% upfront milestone payment for the first two months of usage. Prefer the processing fee unless Sales wants the milestone.
- Addendum language: "Customer payment terms Net45; vendor to issue consolidated monthly statement; PO number required on invoice; Redwood reserves right to suspend service after 90 days of non-payment." Finance will prepare the addendum template.

If Sales wants to approve the onboarding credit, confirm the final discount % and we’ll reflect that on the quote. Please provide the completed vendor onboarding form and W9/Tax ID for our records (they asked for ours — we will share Redwood's remit and tax info once Legal signs the addendum).

Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@greenfieldhealth.com>, Mark Liu <mark.liu@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-20T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing & PO process for Redwood services — confirmation

Hi Sarah / Mark,

Thanks — we can accommodate the billing flow you requested with the following agreed items:

1) Payment terms: Net45 for the first 12 months, subject to review at renewal.
2) Invoice cadence: consolidated monthly statement sent to accounts.payable@greenfieldhealth.com. Each invoice will display the PO number and line-level detail.
3) PO requirement: Please issue a signed PO referencing deal GFH-2026-042 prior to the first invoice (PO number to appear on the invoice).
4) Processing fee: A 1% processing fee will be applied to invoices when Net45 is in effect (this is to offset extended credit risk). If you prefer instead to provide a 25% upfront milestone, we can accept that in lieu of the fee — let us know which you prefer.

Next steps:
- I’ve asked Legal to prepare an MSA addendum capturing Net45/PO requirements and service suspension clause (attached).
- Please complete and return the vendor onboarding form and the signed PO. I’ll send the DocuSign link for the addendum once I have the PO number.

DocuSign link (pre-populated): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
Attachment: MSA_Addendum_Net45.pdf

If this looks good, please confirm PR contact for AP and the expected PO issuance date so we can schedule kickoff.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
